label: lem:continuous_interval_integrable
title: Continuous functions are interval integrable
statement: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; b = [\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$. Then $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,b]$ with respect to the Lebesgue measure (i.e.\ \texttt{IntervalIntegrable f volume a b}). In Mathlib this is \texttt{ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable}.
proof: This is a standard Mathlib result. Continuous functions on compact intervals are bounded and measurable, hence integrable.
